content:
Jin Park: kicking off canary for Deimos-28B (int4). seeing rare OOMs during long multi-turn generations (~1500-2k tokens). Need quick mitigation plan.
Omar V: thanks. single-request or batch combos?
Jin Park: usually single tenant long gen + 1-2 small concurrent batches. GPU shows lots of tiny free slabs -> fragmentation.
Sasha L: did onboarding enable aggressive prefetch and large reserve_fraction?
Jin Park: onboarding template had prefetch=true and reserve_fraction=0.65. I ran a local smoke disabling prefetch and lowering reserve_fraction to 0.5 and it fixed the OOMs.
Omar V: can you paste the runtime patch you tested?
Jin Park: patch snippet: ```
model: deimos-28b-int4
batching:
  max_batch_size: 4
  preferred_batch_size: [1,2]
  batch_timeout_ms: 8
prefetch:
  enabled: false
kv_cache:
  reserve_fraction: 0.5
  slot_compactor: {enabled: true, sweep_sec: 600}
allocator_flags:
  temp_scratch_return_eagerly: true  # feature-flagged kernel tweak
generation:
  default_max_new_tokens: 300
  max_seq_len: 4096
```
Sasha L: nice. the allocator flag is risky but helps fragmentation by releasing sgratch quickly. make it a feature flag and off for prod until validated.
Jin Park: done - feature flag scoped to canary. infra-bot: rolled patch to 2/4 canary pods.
infra-bot: smoke job queued: 100 long-gen traces across updated pods.
Jin Park: quick results from smoke: prefetch=false + temp_scratch=true + reserve_fraction=0.5 -> 100/100 succeeded, median token time +4% vs baseline, GPU mem stable.
eval-bot: deimos-28b-int4 eval snapshot: ROUGE-L delta to float32 -0.9%, KBQA EM -1.1% (within canary threshold).
Omar V: good. propose router heuristic: if requested_max_new_tokens >= 800 route to "no-prefetch" pool. Also add adaptive cap: effective_max = min(requested, default_max) unless tenant quota allows override.
Sasha L: add runtime metric frag_ratio = largest_free_block / total_free_mem and alert when frag_ratio < 0.32 for 5m. Track per-pod and per-model.
Jin Park: added dashboard panel and alert rule. PR branch `canary/deimos-allocator-flag` updated with checklist and rollback criteria: rollback if >2 OOMs/hr or frag_ratio alert fires 3 times in 1h.
infra-bot: smoke-run results: 0 OOMs, 2 timeouts (retries succeeded), frag_ratio median 0.62 -> 0.58 after patch, good stability.
Omar V: follow-ups: 1) run 24h canary with real prompt set 2) if stable, stage to reserved clusters with slightly higher reserve_fraction but keep allocator flag off and compactor sweep more frequent there.
Sasha L: also add nightly low-QPS long-gen job to exercise compactor; include a small eval for int4 drift.
Jin Park: tagging @oncall. will paste 12h and 24h metrics here. thanks team. :thumbsup:
